name: temperature
description: Divides the model's logits before sampling. 1.0 leaves the distribution unchanged; lower values concentrate probability on likely tokens, higher values spread it to other tokens.

name: top_p
description: Samples only from the smallest set of tokens whose probabilities add up to this value. 1.0 disables the cut.

name: top_k
description: Samples only from this many most probable tokens. 0 disables the cut.

name: repetition_penalty
description: Divides the probability of every token that has already appeared in the prompt or the generated text, digits and symbols included. 1.0 applies no change.

name: frequency_penalty
description: Subtracts from a token's logit in proportion to how many times it has already appeared in the generated text. 0 applies no change.

name: presence_penalty
description: Subtracts a fixed amount from the logit of every token that has appeared at least once in the generated text. 0 applies no change.

name: min_p
description: Drops tokens whose probability is below this fraction of the most probable token's probability. 0 disables the cut.

name: ignore_eos
description: Continue sampling after EOS; the experiment token cap still applies.

name: stop_token_ids
description: Token IDs that stop generation. Add tokenizer-verified candidates before allowing changes.

name: allowed_token_ids
description: Restrict sampling to verified token IDs; an empty allowlist is invalid.

name: logit_bias
description: Adds a fixed amount to the logit of the listed tokens (the group name says which words). Negative amounts make them less likely, positive amounts more likely. The group named wrap_up acts on the token that closes the thinking block.

name: output_kind
description: Native request-output representation; not an answer-quality control.

name: logprobs
description: Observation-only output log probabilities; not a quality control.

name: prompt_logprobs
description: Observation-only prompt log probabilities; not a quality control.

name: min_tokens
description: Minimum generated tokens before stopping, restricted to zero or one so it remains valid for short segments.

name: detokenize
description: Return decoded text alongside generated token IDs; output representation only.

name: skip_special_tokens
description: Omit special tokens when decoding output text; output representation only.

name: spaces_between_special_tokens
description: Insert spaces between adjacent special tokens in decoded output; output representation only.

name: include_stop_str_in_output
description: Whether decoded output includes the stop string; only relevant when a stop string is configured.

name: flat_logprobs
description: Return log probabilities in a flattened representation; observation only.

name: bad_words
description: Prevents the listed words from being generated.

name: repetition_detection
description: Ends the current segment when a token pattern of the given length repeats the given number of times.

presets.label: Detect short loops: a 2-8 token pattern repeated 4 times
